title: click.prompt and click.confirm prompt_suffix no longer works when suffix is empty
root_cause_summary: prompt() and confirm() used echo(text.rstrip(' ')) then return f(' ') to work around a readline issue. When prompt_suffix was empty string, this still appended a space. Fix changes approach: echo(text[:-1]) then return f(text[-1:]) so the last character of the prompt (which may be empty) is handled correctly.
notes: No double-quoted strings, no file path in issue. Backtick strings include prompt_suffix, click.prompt, click.confirm, rstrip. Error Sources will find prompt_suffix in termui.py. Hard case: requires behavioral reasoning about prompt rendering. 2-source-file fix.
